summary: Research supports one distinct Nopetro Renewables, LLC RNG platform formed in 2023 by NOVA Infrastructure and Nopetro Energy Holdings, separate from Nopetro Energy's conventional fueling business and from project SPVs. NOVA's Fund I attribution and current platform ownership are directly supported, but the reported 55% stake could not be independently verified from the paywalled secondary source and possible Green Group direct equity remains unresolved.
blockingQuestions: Determine whether Green Group holds any direct platform equity outside its relationship with NOVA; the accepted response explicitly marks this current-owner question UNRESOLVED.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: The exact legal formation and closing dates, NOVA member vehicle, Nopetro Energy Holdings member vehicle and contribution mechanics are not publicly disclosed.
The reported NOVA 55% stake must remain unstructured and qualified unless a directly accessible source independently verifies it.
recommendedActions: Retain the proposed one-company boundary for Nopetro Renewables, LLC and keep Vero Beach, Manatee County and related SPVs beneath it.
Retain NOVA Infrastructure Fund I as a proven active direct owner from the May 31, 2023 announcement, but do not store 55% as an exact structured stake on the present evidence.
Retain Nopetro Energy Holdings as the disclosed co-owner while leaving its exact percentage unstructured because 45% is only an inferred residual.
Resolve possible Green Group direct equity before applying the final owner set.
Keep Nopetro Energy's conventional CNG fueling and fleet-services operations outside this PortCo boundary.
